# Contributing

Thanks for taking the time to contribute!

## Quick start

1. Fork the repo and create a feature branch.
2. Keep changes focused and easy to review.
3. Test locally (see `README.md`).
4. Open a pull request with a clear description and screenshots/GIFs if UI changed.

## Project guidelines

- Prefer small, readable changes over large rewrites.
- Keep the game playable on both desktop and mobile.
- Avoid adding heavy dependencies unless there is a strong reason.
- Keep UI text short (retro font) and avoid noisy animations.

## Reporting bugs

Please include:

- Browser + version
- Repro steps
- Expected vs actual behavior
- Console errors (if any)
